format: Demeter factual extraction; not official publisher JSON
citation: Rodriguez et al. JAMA Network Open. 2025;8(1):e2457349.
license: Article CC-BY; extracted numeric facts with attribution
population: US adults with BMI >=27 initiating liraglutide, injectable semaglutide or tirzepatide in 2018-2023; follow-up through 2024-11-05
outcome: Kaplan-Meier first-event probability by 1 year; discontinuation = >=60 days without medication; reinitiation = first fill after discontinuation
uncertainty: 95% confidence intervals, not independent sampling distributions
limitations: Observational dispensing histories; not randomized access effects or national eligibility estimates.
Reinitiation analysis selected people with weight recorded around discontinuation and after; not all discontinuers.
Annual model also applies access and supply interruptions; importing aggregate discontinuation as a separate clinical hazard would double count barriers.
